archReview.notes: ff_jpeg_fdct_islow_8 RVV (libavcodec/riscv/fdctdsp_rvv.S): both passes of the 8-point LL&M butterfly are lane-wise on 8 vectors. Pass 1 loads the block as 8 column vectors (vlse16, stride 16) so the row butterfly (pairs x0+x7, x1+x6, ...) is element-wise across the column vectors; results stored back column-wise (vsse16, stride 16), reproducing the C row-major intermediate in place. Pass 2 reloads rows (vle16) and reuses the identical butterfly macro. All multiplies in e32 mod 2^32; DESCALE(x,n)=(x+(1<<(n-1)))>>n via vadd.vx+vsra.vi; int16 truncation via vnsrl.wi; pass1 even outputs are <<PASS1_BITS (vsll.vi). Matches jfdctint_template.c bit-exactly (sim 30 cases x 64 coeffs = 0/1920). Registration gated on 8-bit, RVV_I32, vlen>=128, dct_algo not FASTINT/FAAN. arch-scan 0.
